
## Parameters
```{r parameters}
years    <- 2014:2021
lonLim   <- c(-9.5, 4.3)
latLim   <- c(36, 44)
datasets  <- c("ERA5Land", "CIDE", "HARMONIE")
datasets_labels <- c("ERA5-Land", "CIDE", "HARMONIE-AROME")
variables <- c("FWI", "ISI", "Wind")
```

## Library
```{r library, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(loadeR)
library(visualizeR)
devtools::load_all("transformeR")
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(png)
library(sp)
library(raster)
library(terra)
source("load_data.R")
```

## Load region clusters
```{r clusters}
clusters_sp <- as(vect("data/cluster_regions.shp"), "Spatial")
region_obj  <- readRDS("data/region_k3.rds")
region_mask <- as.vector(drop(region_obj$Data))
region_lvls <- c("E", "SW", "N")   # cluster 1, 2, 3
```

## Region labels
```{r check_region_labels, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
library(RColorBrewer)

cols <- brewer.pal(3, "Set2")

print(spatialPlot(
  region_obj,
  backdrop.theme  = "countries",
  main            = "Region labels",
  col.regions     = cols,
  at              = seq(0.5, 3.5, 1),
  colorkey        = list(labels = list(at = 1:3, labels = region_lvls)),
  sp.layout       = list(list(clusters_sp, first = FALSE, col = "black", lwd = 1.5))
))
```

## Weather-type filter (clusters 5 & 6)
```{r wt_filter}
a         <- readRDS("data/fwt_typing.rds")
in_range  <- a$date >= "2014-01-01" & a$date <= "2021-12-31"
time_idx  <- which(a$cl[in_range] %in% 5:6)
```

## Load & filter data
```{r load_data}
# dat[[var]][[ds]]
dat <- setNames(lapply(variables, function(v) {
  setNames(lapply(datasets, function(ds) {
    d <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim,
                   what = v, dataset = ds)
    subsetDimension(d, dimension = "time", indices = time_idx)
  }), datasets)
}), variables)
```

## Climatologies
```{r climatologies}
clim_fun <- function(FUN) list(FUN = function(x) FUN(x, na.rm = TRUE))

clim <- lapply(dat, function(vdat) list(
  mean = lapply(vdat, climatology, clim.fun = clim_fun(mean)),
  p95  = lapply(vdat, climatology, clim.fun = clim_fun(
    function(x, ...) quantile(x, 0.95, ...)))
))

temporal_metrics <- function(model_grid, reference_grid) {
  model_ts <- apply(model_grid$Data, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  reference_ts <- apply(reference_grid$Data, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  valid <- is.finite(model_ts) & is.finite(reference_ts)

  rho_s <- suppressWarnings(cor(model_ts[valid], reference_ts[valid], method = "spearman"))
  mae   <- mean(abs(model_ts[valid] - reference_ts[valid]), na.rm = TRUE)

  sprintf("ρs = %.2f, MAE = %.2f", rho_s, mae)
}

comparison_labels <- list(
  FWI = setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
    temporal_metrics(dat$FWI[[ds]], dat$FWI$CIDE)
  }), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE")),
  FWI95 = setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
    temporal_metrics(dat$FWI[[ds]], dat$FWI$CIDE)
  }), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE")),
  ISI = setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
    temporal_metrics(dat$ISI[[ds]], dat$ISI$CIDE)
  }), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE")),
  Wind = setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
    temporal_metrics(dat$Wind[[ds]], dat$Wind$CIDE)
  }), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"))
)
```

## Spatial maps
```{r spatial_maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=4, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
make_multigrid <- function(clist) {
  for (i in seq_along(datasets)) {
    ds <- datasets[i]
    attr(clist[[ds]]$Variable, "longname") <- datasets_labels[i]
  }
  do.call(makeMultiGrid, c(clist, list(skip.temporal.check = TRUE)))
}

sp_layout <- list(list(clusters_sp, first = FALSE, col = "black", lwd = 1.5))

map_specs <- list(
  list(grid = make_multigrid(clim$Wind$mean), main = "Wind",       color = "YlGn",   at = FALSE),
  list(grid = make_multigrid(clim$Wind$p95), main = "Wind95",       color = "YlGn",   at = FALSE),
  list(grid = make_multigrid(clim$FWI$mean),  main = "FWI",        color = "YlOrRd", at = seq(0, 120, 5)),
  list(grid = make_multigrid(clim$FWI$p95),   main = "FWI95",    color = "YlOrRd", at = seq(0, 120, 5)),
  list(grid = make_multigrid(clim$ISI$mean),  main = "ISI",        color = "Blues",  at = FALSE)
)

for (s in map_specs) {
  if (!isFALSE(s$at)) {
    print(spatialPlot(s$grid, main = s$main, layout = c(3, 1),
                      color.theme = s$color, at = s$at, set.max = 120,
                      sp.layout = sp_layout))
  } else {
    print(spatialPlot(s$grid, main = s$main, layout = c(3, 1),
                      color.theme = s$color,
                      sp.layout = sp_layout))
  }
}
```

## Violin plots
```{r violin_combined, fig.width=8.27, fig.height=11.69, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
make_violin_df <- function(clist) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(datasets), function(m) {
    vals_all <- as.vector(drop(clist[[m]]$Data))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(region_lvls), function(k) {
      vals <- vals_all[region_mask == k]
      data.frame(value   = vals[!is.na(vals)],
                 dataset = datasets_labels[m],
                 region  = factor(region_lvls[k], levels = region_lvls))
    }))
  }))
}

violin_plot <- function(df, ylab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = value, fill = dataset)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~region, ncol = length(region_lvls)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 7, angle = 15, hjust = 1))
}

violin_specs <- list(
  list(df = make_violin_df(clim$Wind$mean), ylab = "Wind"),
  list(df = make_violin_df(clim$FWI$mean),  ylab = "FWI"),
  list(df = make_violin_df(clim$FWI$p95),   ylab = "FWI95"),
  list(df = make_violin_df(clim$ISI$mean),  ylab = "ISI")
)

plots    <- lapply(violin_specs, function(s) violin_plot(s$df, s$ylab))
combined <- Reduce(`/`, plots)
print(combined)
```

## Bias in FWI and FWI95
```{r bias_fwi}
# CIDE as reference
bias_fwi_mean <- setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
  gridArithmetics(clim$FWI$mean[[ds]], clim$FWI$mean$CIDE, operator = "-")
}), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"))

bias_fwi_p95 <- setNames(lapply(c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"), function(ds) {
  gridArithmetics(clim$FWI$p95[[ds]], clim$FWI$p95$CIDE, operator = "-")
}), c("ERA5Land", "HARMONIE"))
```

```{r bias_fwi_multigrid, fig.width=14, fig.height=6, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
# build a 3-panel multigrid (ERA5Land, CIDE (zero), HARMONIE)
bias_fwi_mean_grid <- list(
  ERA5Land = bias_fwi_mean$ERA5Land,
  HARMONIE = bias_fwi_mean$HARMONIE
)
attr(bias_fwi_mean_grid$ERA5Land$Variable, "longname") <- paste0("ERA5-Land − CIDE ", comparison_labels$FWI$ERA5Land)
attr(bias_fwi_mean_grid$HARMONIE$Variable, "longname") <- paste0("HARMONIE-AROME − CIDE ", comparison_labels$FWI$HARMONIE)
spatialPlot(do.call(makeMultiGrid, c(bias_fwi_mean_grid, list(skip.temporal.check = TRUE))), backdrop.theme = "countries",
            color.theme = "RdBu", rev.colors = TRUE,
            main      = "FWI Bias",
            layout    = c(2, 1),
            sp.layout = sp_layout)

# p95 bias
bias_fwi_p95_grid <- list(
  ERA5Land = bias_fwi_p95$ERA5Land,
  HARMONIE = bias_fwi_p95$HARMONIE
)
attr(bias_fwi_p95_grid$ERA5Land$Variable, "longname") <- paste0("ERA5-Land − CIDE ", comparison_labels$FWI95$ERA5Land)
attr(bias_fwi_p95_grid$HARMONIE$Variable, "longname") <- paste0("HARMONIE-AROME − CIDE ", comparison_labels$FWI95$HARMONIE)
spatialPlot(do.call(makeMultiGrid, c(bias_fwi_p95_grid, list(skip.temporal.check = TRUE))), backdrop.theme = "countries",
            color.theme = "RdBu", rev.colors = TRUE,
            main      = "FWI95 Bias",
            layout    = c(2, 1),
            sp.layout = sp_layout)
```
